subject.title: Feature: Processing indicator message for Telegram (send ⌛️ while thinking, delete on reply)

question: Should this exact Telegram placeholder-message lifecycle stay as the canonical request, be folded into the reaction/typing presence work, or move into a broader cross-channel acknowledgment-text design?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but adding visible feedback changes Telegram UX, config defaults, authorization placement, and overlaps with open presence and cross-channel acknowledgment work.

options.title: Keep Placeholder Request Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open for the exact standalone send/delete/edit message lifecycle while using the related presence and ack-text items only as design context.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Presence
options.body: Treat the reaction/typing presence PR as the intended Telegram product direction and close this only after that direction lands or maintainers explicitly reject placeholder messages.

options.title: Move To Cross-Channel Ack Text
options.body: Make the broader acknowledgment-text issue own the feature and close this after it preserves the Telegram-specific requirements or documents why they are out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Placeholder Request Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the exact standalone send/delete/edit message lifecycle while using the related presence and ack-text items only as design context.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current-main author/merger on the central Telegram and config code in this shallow history and already provided maintainer review context on this issue.
